lev20_7.p1: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy:
lev20_7.p2: for I am the LORD your God.

ps51_10.p1: Create in me a clean heart, O God;
ps51_10.p2: and renew a right spirit within me.

ezk36_26.p1: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you:
ezk36_26.p2: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

1th4_7.p1: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness,

1th5_23.p1: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly;
1th5_23.p2: and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

heb10_10.p1: By the which will we are sanctified
heb10_10.p2: through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

1pe1_16.p1: Because it is written, Be ye holy;

isa43_11.p1: I, even I, am the LORD;
isa43_11.p2: and beside me there is no saviour.

isa45_22.p1: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth:
isa45_22.p2: for I am God, and there is none else.

isa53_5.p1: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities:
isa53_5.p2: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

jn14_6.p1: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life:
jn14_6.p2: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

jn10_9.p2: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

acts4_12.p1: Neither is there salvation in any other:
acts4_12.p2: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

1tim2_5.p2: and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

jn3_16.p1: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son,
jn3_16.p2: that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
